attempts.certificate: 1. 用 p=r=(p&r)|(!p&!r)，再用 a>b=!a|b，原式化为 p|r|!q。2. (q>p)|(!q>!r)=(!q|p)|(q|!r)=真，而原式不恒真，故否。3. (p=q)&(q=!p) 为矛盾，可写 p&!p；⇓ 为 NOR，故 !((p|q)⇓(p|q))=p|q。4.(1) 不成立，例如 p=真、r=假、q=假时左右分别为假、真；(2) ⇑为 NAND，p⇑q=!p|!q，成立。5. 按 (p,s) 分情况计数：00 有0组，01 有2组，10 有1组，11 有0组，总数为3。

judges.reason: The canonical answer to item 5 is wrong. There are three assignments with exactly two true statements: (p,q,r,s)=(0,1,0,1), (0,1,1,1), and (1,0,1,0). Thus the requested count is 3, not 2.
judges.depth_evidence: Difficulty scoring is not applicable because the canonical answer is incorrect.
judges.explanation_evidence: Explanation scoring is not applicable because the puzzle's canonical answer is incorrect; the certificate's item 5 count of 3 agrees with the direct enumeration.
